name: Military Logistics Sim
description: Reusable test module for the logistics sim API, including session setup, RWD refresh, weather refresh, and dev feature toggles.
targetHint: Use with the sim API at http://localhost:5080

variables.label: Seed
variables.description: Seed used when creating a session.

features.label: Route Severity
features.description: Example sprint feature toggle representing the route severity slice.

features.label: Real Weather
features.description: Example sprint feature toggle representing the real-weather slice.

features.label: Dashboard Skin
features.description: Example sprint feature toggle representing the cinematic dashboard skin.

actions.title: Create Session
actions.description: Creates a new sim session and captures the returned sessionId.

actions.title: Get World Data Status
actions.description: Reads the current world snapshot metadata and live weather status.

actions.title: Get World State
actions.description: Reads the current world state payload including embedded world-data info.

actions.title: Update Real World Data
actions.description: Rebuilds the static RWD snapshot for the current session.

actions.title: Refresh Weather
actions.description: Forces a live weather refresh for the current session.

actions.title: Apply Dev Features
actions.description: Pushes dev toggle settings into the active session.
